title: Squirt angle versus impact parameter (calibration target)
purpose: The squirt model is a calibration curve, not a closed form. This fixture fixes the shape and the anchors; the amplitude is a config parameter that playtesting or measurement sets.
sources: Kim 2021: squirt increases almost linearly for b < 0.5R

setup.note: the cue ball is struck at a range of impact parameters b; the squirt angle is the deflection of the resulting velocity from the cue axis

expectations.notes: a centre-ball hit has no squirt
TO BE CALIBRATED from Cross 2008 or high-speed video
TO BE CALIBRATED; roughly 1-5 deg at maximum english

invariants.statement: squirt increases monotonically with the impact parameter and vanishes at b = 0
the curve is nearly linear up to b = 0.5R and flattens beyond (Kim 2021)
